name: crowd
title: Crowd — 100,000 mostly idle actors
summary: Ramps to 100,000 mostly idle actors while a Markov model learned from a recorded history pokes them; shows bytes per actor and growth by relocation.
description: Ramps a null-datamodel system to 100k sensor actors while a Markov model learned from a recorded sensor history pokes random sensors. Each poke arms a delayed send, so the timer heap and event pool breathe with the load. Shows bytes per actor and growth by relocation.

poke-all.title: Poke every sensor
poke-all.description: One event to every actor at once (pool surge)
